Slot.title: Slot
Slot.description: Represents an individual carpet display rack slot (e.g. 1a, 1b).

slotLetter.description: The slot position on the rack (a or b).

occupied.description: Whether a carpet is currently placed in this slot.

productName.description: The name or model of the carpet.

ean.description: The EAN-13 barcode of the carpet.

referenceNumber.description: The Leroy Merlin internal reference number (ref).

eslCode.description: The electronic shelf label (ESL) code or barcode.

price.description: The product price formatted as string (e.g. 399,00 zł).

imageUrl.description: Optional image URL of the product.

updatedBy.description: Email or identifier of the user who performed the last update.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

createdAt.description: Creation timestamp. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/slots/{slotId}.description: Collection of all display rack slots across the warehouse/store.
